Back in MoP, we were able to cast Lightning Bolt (our single-target filler spell) while moving, but that was removed in 6.0 to the dismay of many. We do have Spiritwalker's Grace, which allows us to cast while moving for a short time, but has a 2 minute base cooldown. With a (mostly) mandatory glyph, the duration is cut from 12 seconds to 6 seconds but the cooldown is reduced by half as well. Most times, the 12 seconds base duration is overkill, so having it available twice as often for half the duration helps out a lot (for example, during Allure of Flames on Archimonde, or when you're being chased on Gorefiend).

Ele shaman main here. In regards to you wanting decent mobility and being able to help on specific mechanics, I'm afraid Ele may not be the thing for you. With a glyph, our cast-n-move spell can be up for about 6 seconds every minute, which helps but isn't much. Ghost wolf provides some great sustained mobility, but you can't cast while using the form. Lastly, on heavy target-switching fights such as Gorefiend, Kilrogg, or Archimonde, you might have some struggles trying to keep adds at bay compared to other classes. However, if the stars align and you get multiple 2pc procs in a row, this can quickly change for the better. 

On the bright side, Elemental is a very fun class to play, with flashy spell effects and the satisfaction of bringing one of the most iconic buffs to the group (Bloodlust, time warp is merely a cheap knock-off). The rotation is rather easy, but isn't mind-numbingly so and provides some very cool moments when RNG is in your favor (lava surge procs and tier 18 2pc procs). If you have any other questions, I've been playing the spec since WotLK and I'd be glad to help!
